answer: Histories are stored in mesa, checked in shale, and ivory makes public each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 4172 identities would post 1955 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
